title: Tatuerad · vila · två små rörelser (andas, vickar)
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: från och till ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. Two very small movements with a still moment between. First she takes one slow, calm breath: her chest and shoulders rise a little and settle, and she blinks. Halfway through she is exactly as in the first frame again and holds still. Then her head tilts a little to one side with a small closed-lip smile and comes back upright. Her hands stay exactly where they are. The plain green background, the shoe and the edges of the picture stay exactly as in the first frame all the way. The tattoos on her hands and throat keep their pattern.
